countries.reasoning: Chile is the world's largest copper producer, primarily from oxide and sulfide ores; USGS 2023 data confirms high production volumes with detailed reporting.
Peru is a major copper producer with extensive oxide ore production; data from USGS 2023 and Peruvian mining authority statistics are reliable.
China produces significant copper oxide concentrates, supported by multiple large mines; data from China Statistical Yearbook and USGS 2023.
The US has notable copper oxide production, notably from mines in Arizona; USGS 2023 provides detailed and consistent data.
Zambia is a major African copper producer with large oxide mining operations; data from Zambian mining reports and USGS 2023, although some reporting lags exist.
